caption: The drawing depicts a large ceramic jug or crock, shown in full from the front and centered on the page. The jug is tan or light brown in color with two ear-like handles on each side beneath the neck. The rim of the jug is slightly flared and appears darker on the inside. The surface features an elaborate blue decorative motif, depicting a bird with a long, arched tail and perched on a blue leafy branch. Above the bird, in blue, are the words "J. H. WANDS OLEAN, N.Y." indicating possible maker or place, and the number "4" suggesting its capacity in gallons. The main drawing is surrounded by a rectangular border, and in the upper left corner there is a smaller inset showing a detailed close-up of the bird motif in blue. In the lower right corner, another smaller inset displays a close-up of the jug's rim. The overall composition uses shades of tan, brown, and blue, with detailed rendering to highlight the texture and design of the jug and its decoration.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
